text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: inference-runtime error rate spike in us-west-2 (5m > threshold). Severity: P1. Affected service: text-generation, model: gptx-3-small-quant. Logs flagged at 3032106788.
Samira (oncall): acked. I'm on it. @Jordan can you take lead on runtime side? Priya, plz monitor infra. Marta, any customer reports yet?
Jordan (runtime): looking. Early signal shows KV cache miss ratio jumped ~4x after a quant profile flip earlier this morning. Not seeing OOMs, but increased latency + tail errors. Investigating whether quant change altered key hashing behavior. Poking logs now.
Jordan (runtime): logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] kvcache: miss_ratio=0.42 prev=0.09 profile=quant-v2.3
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] batcher: queue_len=128 latency_p95=980ms
[2026-03-15T09:12:04Z] runtime: request_err=502 downstream_timeout
```
Priya (sre): If KV miss ratio spiked we should reduce batch size and enable aggressive KV eviction throttle. Recommend: set BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024 -> 512 and flip KVCACHE_THROTTLE=on. That should reduce request amplification.
Samira (oncall): plan: (1) Jordan runs mitigation (batch size down, throttle on). (2) If mitigations don't work in 10m, revert quant profile to quant-v2.1. (3) Support to notify impacted customers. I'll update every 10 minutes.
Marta (support): confirming two enterprise customers reporting 502s and elevated latencies: acme-corp (prod) and betachat (staging). Support ticket snippets: "calls time out ~1s then 502". I'll post status pages and CC account teams.
Evan (eng): quick note: there was an automated canary that promoted quant-v2.3 at 06:40; rollout window was 30m. We can roll that back fast with `deploy rollback quant-v2.3 --to quant-v2.1 --region us-west-2`. Jordan, want me to run it if you need hands?
Jordan (runtime): running mitigations now. Commands: ```
# reduce batch size
rigctl set-config --service inference --key BATCH_MAX_TOKENS --value 512 --region us-west-2
# enable kv throttle
rigctl set-config --service inference --key KVCACHE_THROTTLE --value true --region us-west-2
```
Jordan (runtime): changes applied. Observability: queue_len dropping, p95 latency trending down from 980ms -> 420ms at +3m. Error rate down 60% so far. Continuing to watch.
incident-bot: Automated update: errors decreased to 40% of peak, latency p95 improved. Next automated check in 10m.
Samira (oncall): good signal. @Evan hold off on rollback for now — leave rollback as fall-back. Jordan continue monitoring for 30m and confirm stable. Priya, check infra headroom for autoscaling artifacts.
Priya (sre): infra looks fine; no CPU/GPU pressure, autoscaler healthy. The throttle introduced a small increase in single-token latency but reduced amplification. Seems like expected tradeoff.
Marta (support): posted customer status updates: acme-corp notified (we offered workaround: retry/backoff), betachat updated. No escalations for contract breaches at this time.
Jordan (runtime): 25m after mitigation: error rate near baseline, p95 stable ~380ms. KV cache miss ratio back down to ~0.11. Looks healthy. I'll leave the KV throttle on for 24h and then evaluate.
Samira (oncall): closing the pager in 30m if stable. Preparing post-incident follow-up: we need a postmortem focused on quant profile validation and KV cache interaction.
Postmortem-bot: Postmortem draft created: GH issue #4567 - "kv-cache amplification after quant-v2.3 rollout". Template attached. Meeting scheduled: 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC. Link: https://calendar.example/meet/pm-4567
Samira (oncall): action items captured in GH #4567: 1) Add extra canary metrics for kv miss ratio and batch amplification (owner: Jordan, due: 2026-03-22). 2) Add automated canary rollback threshold for miss ratio > 2x baseline (owner: Evan, due: 2026-03-19). 3) Improve docs for quant profile compatibility with KV hashing (owner: Runtime-docs, due: 2026-03-29). 4) Support runbook update for notifying customers + templated guidance (owner: Marta, due: 2026-03-18).
Jordan (runtime): I'll also add a regression test in the eval harness that simulates quant-induced key variance and measures cache hit distribution. Will PR to infra-tests today.
Evan (eng): noted. I'll scope the canary rollback automation - will include a safe dry-run flag.
Priya (sre): recommend we keep KVCACHE_THROTTLE default off but enable it as an emergency toggle in console with clearer description. Adding to GH issue as well.
Samira (oncall): thanks all. Final status: mitigated via config changes, rollback unnecessary. Postmortem scheduled, owners assigned. I'll update incident channel when postmortem is published. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager resolved at 3032107885. Close reason: mitigated (config throttle + reduced batching).
Samira (oncall): closing thread, will follow up in GH. If anyone has lingering notes add them to #4567.
